title: Kneworth K220 High tensile Aluminium Custom Built Aluminium Road Train Bullbar #106
description: Kenworth K200 high tensile aluminium FUPS and Radar (AEB) compliant Road train bull bar, Disibio style channel with vents to cool oil cooler & spotlight mounts allow maximum clearance from back of light to cab. 88mm pipe. main pipes are one piece passing through drilled heavy duty uprights. Heavy duty tow pin in steel backing plate. Flip over aluminium Road Train signs.
